argent: 6 units with AFB, Space Cannon or Bombardment on the board
keleres: Spend 1 TG after playing a component-action card
mahact: 2 other factions' tokens in your fleet pool
naalu: Ground forces in or next to Mecatol Rex
nekro: Own 3 techs (Valefar only counts with a token on it)
winnu: Control Mecatol Rex, or fight in its system
yin: Use one of your faction abilities
crimson: Breach token in a system with another player's unit
ral-nel: Be the last player to pass in the action phase
